question:
(i) Describe the process by which a glass rod and silk acquire charges when rubbed together. Explain the nature of charges acquired by each.
(ii) Explain why the charges produced on the two bodies are equal in magnitude and opposite in nature.

options.A:
(i) Electrons transfer from silk to glass; glass becomes negative and silk becomes positive
(ii) The charges are unequal because rubbing creates extra electrons
options.B:
(i) Electrons transfer from glass to silk; glass becomes positive and silk becomes negative
(ii) The charges are equal in magnitude and opposite in nature because electrons lost by glass equal electrons gained by silk
options.C:
(i) Protons transfer from glass to silk; glass becomes negative and silk becomes positive
(ii) The charges are equal because protons are created during rubbing
options.D:
(i) Both glass and silk become positively charged after rubbing
(ii) Their charges are equal because no electrons move
